title: Inline object table versus production find_objects fetch on demand

field_principles.schema: A versioned shape lets readers reject incompatible evidence.
field_principles.experiment: The experiment number binds the result to REQ-ARC-WMTE-6753.
field_principles.title: The title states the paired non-inferiority question.
field_principles.run_date: The requested planning date fixes the evidence period.
field_principles.status: The status distinguishes a complete, partial, or blocked run.
field_principles.field_principles: Every top-level field states why it exists.
field_principles.inference_substrate: The substrate excludes remote, CPU, and helper-only substitutes.
field_principles.duration_s: A monotonic interval shows real elapsed work.
field_principles.random_seed: All arm seeds and the analysis seed make random choices repeatable.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: One digest binds design, prompts, provenance, and rows.
field_principles.models_used: Exact model IDs, roles, paths, and hashes prevent substitution.
field_principles.live_model_invoked: The flag distinguishes live evidence from a dry artifact.
field_principles.context_requested: Every worker owns the fixed 32768-cell context request.
field_principles.gpu_receipts: Per-load device, layer, and memory facts prove CUDA inference.
field_principles.rows: The full fixed denominator keeps failures and sidecars visible.
field_principles.frozen_design: The design records choices made before live rows run.
field_principles.source_receipts: Input hashes bind the preflight, prior evidence, and registry.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Fail-closed host and evidence checks explain admission.
field_principles.mean_prompt_token_savings: The paired baseline-minus-treatment result measures savings.
field_principles.fetch_rate: The row-derived rate reports whether treatment used find_objects.
field_principles.useful_fetch_rate: The strict rate needs returned evidence and a later valid engine.
field_principles.change_fidelity_delta: Treatment-minus-baseline held change fidelity is the main effect.
field_principles.change_fidelity_ci95: A game-clustered interval supports the non-inferiority gate.
field_principles.transition_utility_delta: The paired net changed-cell utility is a second quality view.
field_principles.noninferiority_margin: The frozen prior within-arm mean spread is the allowed loss.
field_principles.harmful_regressions: Games below the frozen margin remain visible.
field_principles.paired_analysis: Per-game and per-seed details make the reducer reproducible.
field_principles.adoption_gate_conditions: Named booleans make adoption independent of completion.
field_principles.adoption_gate_passed: Adoption needs completion, savings, and non-inferiority.
field_principles.object_table_ab_completed: Completion needs every valid science and sidecar row.
field_principles.solve_claim: False prevents induction evidence from becoming a level-solve claim.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Blocked artifacts name the failed check and observed value.
field_principles.verdict_class: A closed class supports machine-readable terminal handling.
field_principles.honest_verdict: The terminal prefix states the owned result without inflation.

frozen_design.question: Is table-absent plus production find_objects non-inferior to the inline table with positive realized prompt-token savings?
frozen_design.pairing_unit: game_and_seed; average seeds inside each game before inference
adoption_conditions: all planned rows have valid provenance
